name: ASI (GE Appliances a Haier Company)
desc:
Inbound Customer Service Agent | $15.00/hr + Incentives 

Company: Advanced Services, Inc. (ASI), a wholly owned subsidiary of GE Appliances
Industry: Consumer Products | Appliance Customer Service & Sales

What Your Day Will Look Like:
 ASI is the dedicated call center that handles all the customer service for GE Appliances owners, and your job is helping people who've called in about their refrigerator, washer, dryer, or other GE appliance. You're troubleshooting issues, answering product questions, helping with registration, and coordinating things like parts, delivery, or finding a dealer, while also looking for genuine opportunities to upsell products, services, warranties, or memberships.
This role blends real customer service with inbound sales expectations, you're expected to hit defined sales metrics and KPIs as a core part of the job, not just resolve calls. You'll be using multiple Windows-based systems at once to log everything, follow guidelines, and occasionally use judgment to offer a reasonable concession when it's in the owner's and the company's best interest.

The schedule here is genuinely different from most call center roles: 4 days a week, 10-hour shifts (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, 7:00 AM-5:30 PM CST), with Wednesdays off and no weekend shifts required.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not explicitly stated in posting.
 Required Experience: 1 year of relevant customer service or sales experience.
 Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out beyond the 1-year requirement.
 Required Skills:
Strong research, analysis, and sound decision-making for escalated issues
High attention to detail and concentration for daily activity management
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication
Comfort navigating multiple web-based systems simultaneously
Ability to work effectively and independently in a home environment
MS Office Suite proficiency
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who wants genuinely no weekend shifts and values a 4-day, 10-hour workweek structure
Participants comfortable balancing customer service with real sales metrics and KPI accountability
Anyone who already has a qualifying local internet provider with an ethernet connection (satellite, prepaid, and DSL are explicitly not allowed)
People who can commit fully to a 9-week training period with zero absences
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need same-day or fast income, since 9 weeks of training comes before full independent work
Anyone using satellite, prepaid, or DSL internet, these are explicitly disqualifying
Someone uncomfortable with sales metrics being a core, required part of a "customer service" role
Participants who can't commit to zero absences during the 9-week training window
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
 Customer service, inbound sales, appliance support, upselling, troubleshooting, KPI performance, Windows-based systems, product registration, escalation resolution, call documentation
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you identified an opportunity to offer an additional product or service to a customer while still solving their original problem.
How do you stay accurate and detail-oriented when managing owner records across multiple systems?
Describe a time you had to use judgment to offer a solution or concession that wasn't strictly by the book.
How do you handle a 10-hour shift while staying sharp and customer-focused the whole time?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway, :

Pay: Base rate of $15.00/hour plus incentives based on quality scores, paid weekly.
 Shift: 10-hour shifts, 4 days a week (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri), 7:00 AM-5:30 PM CST, Wednesdays off, no weekends. Shift bid process occurs twice a year to reassign schedules within business hours of 7am-7pm CST. Training runs 9 weeks, 4 days a week, 10:30 AM-7:00 PM CST, with mandatory 100% attendance.
 Benefits: Paid on-the-job training and mentoring, work-from-home equipment provided, no weekend shifts, PTO, medical/dental/vision/prescription eligible on day one, 401(k) with company match, short and long-term disability, life insurance, appliance discount program, tuition reimbursement, gym membership reimbursement.
 Equipment Provided: Yes, ASI provides work-from-home equipment including dual monitors, keyboard, mouse, cords, and an ethernet cord.
 Felony Friendly?: Not directly confirmed for ASI specifically. Parent company GE Appliances follows ban-the-box practices for some of its manufacturing locations (background checks after a conditional offer, consistent with local ordinances), but this is a separate subsidiary and a remote call center role, so that policy may not directly apply here. Confirm ASI's specific policy directly rather than assuming it mirrors GE Appliances' manufacturing practices.
 Drug Test: Not stated in this posting.
 Notes: The 4-day, 10-hour, no-weekend schedule is a real standout compared to most call center roles in this database, worth highlighting clearly to participants who value a genuine day off structure over spread-out weekday-only hours. This role has real sales expectations built into a customer service title, KPIs and sales metrics are described as a "core requirement," not a bonus. Set that expectation clearly so participants understand this isn't purely a support role. Internet requirements are specific and disqualifying if not met: local provider with ethernet connection only, no satellite, prepaid, or DSL. Confirm a participant's home setup before referring them.


Career Pathway: Inbound Customer Service Agent → Senior Customer Service Agent → Team Lead → Contact Center Supervisor → Contact Center Operations Manager
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
